title: Best of Vietnam and Cambodia in Fifteen Days
alt: Ta Prohm ruins held together by tree roots at Angkor
transport: Flights between the cities, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi and Ninh Binh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc and the limestone country around it.

activities.name: Cycle ride to Bich Dong pagoda
activities.description: A cycle ride through the rice fields to Bich Dong, a three tier pagoda built into the rock face.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights in the old quarter, with a full day south to Ninh Binh and a cycle ride to Bich Dong.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · All meals · Cabin with a window · 3★ · Timber cruise boat moored among the karsts overnight

activities.name: Halong Bay overnight cruise
activities.description: A shared cruise out among the limestone islands, with lunch and dinner on board and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay
program.description: A night on the water among the limestone islands, with all meals served on board.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Da Nang, Ba Na and Hoi An
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few streets back from My Khe beach

activities.name: Surprise Cave on Bo Hon island
activities.description: A morning climb into the Surprise Cave, three great chambers of stalactites above the water, before the boat turns back.

activities.name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

activities.name: Hoi An with a Thu Bon river boat ride
activities.match: Hoi An Day Tour from Da Nang with Thu Bon River
activities.description: A day in the old trading town with the Japanese bridge and the merchant houses, and a boat out onto the Thu Bon river as the lanterns come on.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: The flight to the central coast for three nights, with Ba Na Hills and a full day in Hoi An.

stops.name: Phu Quoc
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Beach resort with a spa on the west coast of the island

program.name: Phu Quoc
program.description: Two nights at a beach resort on the island with nothing scheduled at all.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Saigon, Cu Chi and the Mekong
stops.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, a short walk from the opera house

activities.name: Saigon city tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum and the Ben Thanh market.

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels half day tour
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnel Half Day Tour
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through a widened section of the original shafts.

activities.name: Mekong Delta day tour
activities.description: South to My Tho for a boat into the coconut creeks, a sampan through the palms, and the workshops where they make coconut candy.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Three nights in District 1 with the city, the Cu Chi tunnels and a full day in the Mekong Delta.

stops.name: Siem Reap
stops.subtitle: Tonle Sap and Angkor
stops.hotel_label: HARI Residence and Spa Siem Reap
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel with a pool, a short ride from the old market

activities.name: Tonle Sap lake boat ride
activities.match: Boat Ride Tour of Tonle Sap Lake
activities.description: A boat out onto the great lake, through a floating village of houses, schools and shops built on stilts and pontoons.

activities.name: Angkor Wat day tour
activities.description: Angkor Wat itself, the Bayon faces at Angkor Thom and the root covered ruins of Ta Prohm, with a guide for the full day.

program.name: Siem Reap
program.description: On to Cambodia for the last three nights, with the floating villages of Tonle Sap and a full day at Angkor.

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Two weeks, two countries and two nights on a beach in the middle of it. The island is what keeps this one from feeling like a march.
expert.tip: Keep the Phu Quoc days empty as they are here. After six days of touring you will want them back.

summary: Fifteen days across Vietnam and Cambodia: Hanoi with Ninh Binh, an overnight cruise in Halong Bay, three nights in Da Nang for Ba Na Hills and Hoi An, two at a beach resort on Phu Quoc, three in Saigon with the Cu Chi tunnels and the Mekong Delta, then three in Siem Reap for Tonle Sap and Angkor.
included: Included: 14 nights with breakfast daily, dinner at most hotels and all meals on the cruise boat; all flights between the cities; private transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour; a cycle ride to Bich Dong; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge; a Hoi An day tour with a river boat ride; a Saigon city tour; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour; a Mekong Delta day tour; a Tonle Sap lake boat ride; an Angkor Wat day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam and Cambodia visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
